title: Northgate Tire Center Tariff — Charge for a Rotation Visit
content:
# Tariff clause: the rotation visit

**Clause.** The rotation charge on a Northgate Tire Center package is the package's rotation fee for the visit, rounded to the cent, so a package whose rotation fee is zero is charged nothing.

## Application

- **Which visit.** The visit is the most recent rotation entry recorded on the package; the charge is one charge for the whole set, dated on that rotation's work order.
- **Which fee.** The rotation fee per visit of the package held.
- **Rounding.** The charge is carried at full precision and rounded to the cent once, at the end; no intermediate amount is rounded on its own.

## Worked figures (hypothetical fees)

| Hypothetical rotation fee of the package | Rotation charge for the visit |
|---|---|
| $18.00 | $18.00 |
| $0.00 | nothing — $0.00 |
